svg.title: Leave requests, approved by the manager — SoftTrack web design mockup (#248)
svg.desc: Nothing in SoftTrack knows that somebody is away, so a ticket is assigned to a person who left for two weeks yesterday. A leave request has a type, dates and a note and goes to the person’s manager, who approves or refuses with a reason; everybody else sees that the person is away and until when.

svg.text: Done when a person can request leave with a type, a first and last day, half days and a note; it goes to their manager, or to HR when there is none; the manager approves or
refuses with a reason and HR can decide any request; the person can withdraw or cancel before it starts; everyone else sees “away until” on the profile, the assignee picker and
the workload tab, never the type or the note; and sick leave can be recorded after the fact.
